axes.twist: it should feel playful without being childish

prompt: Can you build me a single-page site for our community garden's spring planting day, saved as index.html in this folder with all the CSS and JS inline and no external images (use CSS shapes, emoji, or inline SVG if you need visuals)? It's Saturday, April 18, 9am–1pm at the Maple Street Community Garden, and we're trying to get more families with young kids to come, so the page needs to work for busy parents skimming on their phones: date, time, location, and "what to bring" should be visible right away, plus a short schedule (seed-starting table, worm bin demo, plot tours, potluck at noon), a note that drop-in for an hour is totally fine, and a simple RSVP form with name, email, number of kids, and a checkbox for "I can bring a dish" that just shows a friendly confirmation message on submit. I want it to feel playful and warm, maybe some bouncy hover states or a little sprouting animation, but not cartoonish or babyish; think nice grown-up design with a sense of humor, not a kindergarten flyer.
